evidence.quote: Signal is restricting the ability to take screenshots on Android and iOS devices in an effort to prevent AI agents from reading users’ messages and other data.

title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
displayTitle: Signal限制移动端截图，阻止系统AI读取聊天画面
summary: Signal限制Android及iOS应用截图，以阻止系统AI助手读取聊天画面；用户可在设置中恢复截图，公司承认措施不覆盖所有数据访问路径。
investorNote: 终端Agent的权限设计会同时影响隐私应用、系统平台及依赖无障碍功能的用户。
